name: What's new
author: Brett
description: A What's new widget on the banner: a ticker of the newest features merged to main (and deployed), with an unread count. Tap it for the panel: everything shipped, grouped by date, by build or by app, with search, details (what it does, where to find it, PR and report links), mark read and new-since-last-visit highlighting. Built from what actually shipped (merged pull requests, the builds store, build reports, Codebase changes entries); no model tokens.
